question: Does lazy-greedy maximum expected coverage placement (Church-ReVelle MCLP) beat fixed-separation packing on the same surface, and does a new magnetic triple-gradient surface add further gains?

hypotheses.G43-MCLP01: Covering a continuous [0,1] surface with the official 300-m triangular kernel via submodular greedy maximizes expected kernel credit per dot and beats any fixed spacing constant on the same surface.
hypotheses.G43-MG01: Locations strong in TMI horizontal gradient, |vertical gradient|, and RTP edge simultaneously mark fault-juxtaposed susceptibility contacts, including weak/deep ones absent from the catalogue.

inputs.h42_surface: SH_basin_strong rebuilt exactly as in round 1 (slope, detrended elev, tmi_hg, lidar scarp)
inputs.valid_domain: finite cells within sample_submission.tif footprint intersected with per-arm band validity

mg01_surface.smoothing: mask-aware Gaussian sigma=2.0 px on each input (normalized convolution over valid cells; nearest boundary mode)
mg01_surface.aggregation: weighted geometric mean with 0.05 floor, equal weights (H42 convention); output clipped to [0,1]; 0 outside valid

mclp_placement.objective: maximize sum_j p_j * max_{i in S} k(d_ij) with k(d)=max(1-d/3,0), d in grid cells; |S|=40000
mclp_placement.solver: exact lazy (accelerated) greedy with a max-heap; deterministic tie-break by ascending flat index; cached gains are upper bounds (min of cached and recomputed on push-back)
mclp_placement.candidate_set: top 300000 eligible cells by initial coverage gain g0 (exact 7x7 triangular-kernel convolution); all eligible cells if fewer
mclp_placement.demand_domain_holdout: evaluation-domain cells (held-fold interior after 3-px guard) intersected with surface validity
mclp_placement.demand_domain_submission: full-footprint valid cells (footprint & band-valid), including catalogue-adjacent cells, so boundary dots can cover them
mclp_placement.eligible_holdout: evaluation cells more than 2 px from training traces, intersected with surface validity
mclp_placement.eligible_submission: footprint cells more than 2 px from any catalogue positive, intersected with surface validity (on-catalogue masked pixels excluded; consistent with the 2-px holdout training guard)
mclp_placement.safety: abort with an error (no partial selection) if total marginal-gain recomputes exceed 20000000 in one fold/build

frozen_operators.arm_c_packing: existing stable greedy_pack with min_sep=4.0 px, budget 40000, candidate_cap 2000000

holdout.protocol_source: same frozen protocol as registry/experiment.json (round 1): 4 folds, 200-px blocks, (row//200 + 2*(col//200)) % 4, 3-px edge guard, 2-px training guard
holdout.metric: official 300-m triangular-kernel DTI, no known-mask (held-out positives are truth)
arms: REF recomputed SH_basin_strong|sep4.0|N40000 (protocol-drift guard; must match round-1 receipt within 1e-6 mean/min/max)
C MG01 surface + sep4.0 packing N40000
D SUP01 HGB + sep4.0 N40000 (corrected gate folds 1-3)
E ENS(SH,MG01) + sep4.0 N40000 (corrected gate folds 1-3)

promotion_gate.primary_selection: highest-mean passing arm; tie within 1e-6 prefers the new-geology arm (B over A)

submission_build_if_gate_passes.surface: winning arm surface rebuilt on the full footprint
submission_build_if_gate_passes.emission: MCLP (arms A/B) or sep4.0 packing (arm C, only if C alone passes) at N=40000, binary {0,1}
submission_build_if_gate_passes.normalization: prediction values are binary 1/0, hence within [0,1]; NaN outside footprint; nodata=NaN
artifacts: docs/downloads/<unique>-zeros.tif (all-finite fallback twin, identical inside footprint)

owner_directed_artifact_policy: The owner explicitly requires an easy-to-download unique TIF. The file is published with honest validation labeling either way: if the gate passes it is slot-eligible (still live-UNSCRED); if the gate fails it is published as a research artifact that is NOT recommended for slot use, with the failed gate stated next to the download. No live score is ever claimed without an organizer receipt.
guarantee_scope: (1-1/e) is relative to the optimum over the preregistered 300k candidate set for covering the SURFACE, not for covering hidden truth. It is a placement-quality floor, not a DTI forecast.

primary_gate.gate_definition: corrected round-2b: folds 1-3 mean strictly greater + 3/3 wins (fold 0 excluded as selection fold)

outcome.mclp_verdict: Arms A/B fail (0/4 wins each): exact lazy-greedy max-coverage placement trails fixed sep-4 packing on the same surface; placement optimization cannot fix a miscalibrated surface. See research/amendment_round2b.md and research/mclp_strategy.md.
outcome.interpretation: SUP01 passes the corrected gate (3/3 clean folds + mean) and the original 4-fold gate; slot use is authorized by the gate but the file is live-UNSCRED and the holdout does not forecast organizer scores

amendment_round2b.reason: fold-0 full-budget exploration falsified all MCLP placement variants (best: calibrated demand, -0.037 DTI vs packing); preregistered Arms A/B/C run unchanged on the original gate; backup Arms D (supervised HGB ranker + sep4) and E (SH/MG01 50-50 ensemble + sep4) added, judged on folds 1-3 only (3/3 wins + mean required) because fold 0 selected them

added_arms.D_SUP01_HGB|sep4.0|N40000: HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=200, learning_rate=0.06, max_leaf_nodes=63, min_samples_leaf=200, l2_regularization=1.0, class_weight=balanced, early_stopping=True, validation_fraction=0.1, n_iter_no_change=20, random_state=20261006) on 21 features (19 bands + scarp evidence + scarp-valid flag); greedy_pack sep4.0 N40000
added_arms.E_ENS_SH_MG01|sep4.0|N40000: 50/50 H42-style geometric mean of SH and MG01; greedy_pack sep4.0 N40000

amendment_round2b.corrected_gate_DE: win 3/3 of folds 1-3 vs recomputed H42 reference AND mean(folds1-3) strictly greater; fold 0 reported but excluded
amendment_round2b.primary_selection: among all passing arms, highest 4-fold mean; tie within 1e-6 prefers newest geology D > E > B > A
